counter_thesis: Domestic rebar demand is structurally lower, not cyclically: the FY2025 operating loss and sub-50% YK utilization may be the new normal, the YK acquisition adds fixed cost into a shrinking market, and the declared mid-cycle FCFF path (42bn by year 5) may never be reached; the 16% treasury stake and net cash do not return to shareholders on any declared schedule.

issues.description: the declared Base path assumes spread persistence that only one filed half-year (H1-2026) evidences; FY2025 filed spread (793-407) still produced an operating loss
requested_evidence: 2H26 realized spread from the next quarterly filing

issues.description: attributing consolidated FCFF at the balance-sheet equity ratio 0.8603 simplifies YK minority economics; YK's own losses may not be proportional
